html: † [כֶּ֫סֶת] n.f. band, fillet (= charm or amulet according to Ephr. Syriac, φυλακτήρια according to ὁ Ἑβραῖος of Hexapl., cf. RSJPh. xiii, 286; in NH כסת usually = cushion, bolster, pillow), only pl. מְתַפְּרוֹת כְּסָתוֹת עַל־ Ez 13:18 women sewing bands upon elbows; c. sf. 2 fpl. כִּסְתוֹתֵיכֶ֫נָה v 20.
